title: 115 lbs (50 kg) Devon finger curls for 12
summary: Lift clip of Devon Larratt-style finger curls with 115 lbs (about 50 kg) for 12 reps, set to French rap music. The description recommends them as an excellent forearm exercise when wrist curls hurt.

claims.claim: Devon Larratt finger curls are an excellent forearm exercise if wrist curls hurt.

exercises.name: Devon Larratt finger curls
exercises.why: forearm hypertrophy without the pain of wrist curls
